name: Kroc Row
instructions: Place one hand and the same-side knee on a bench with a flat back, and hold a heavy dumbbell in your other hand.
Row the dumbbell up toward your hip for high reps, allowing a small amount of body English.
Lower the weight to a full stretch and repeat.
Use straps if your grip fails first, and keep your spine neutral.
image_prompt_scene: With one hand and one knee on a bench and a heavy dumbbell hanging in the other hand.
